name: Grade 9 IT Practice: April Week 7 - LED Teamwork
description: Practice words for Grade 9 first-trimester physical computing work.

words.definition: A light that can be controlled separately in a strip or group.
words.example: The addressable LED strip let the team control one pixel at a time.

words.definition: One tiny dot in a digital image or display.
words.example: The first pixel turned blue while the rest stayed off.

words.definition: A sequence of images or changes that looks like movement.
words.example: The animation moved a light pattern across the LED strip.

words.definition: A planned LED color or blink sequence used as a warning signal.
words.example: The team created a red-blue-red pattern for the warning signal.

words.definition: How fast something happens or moves.
words.example: The animation speed changed when the delay value changed.

words.definition: The person who builds the physical parts.
words.example: The builder connected the LED strip and checked the wiring.

words.definition: The person who works on the code.
words.example: The coder edited the loop that controlled the LED pattern.

words.definition: The person who checks if it works.
words.example: The tester ran the program and recorded what worked.

words.definition: The person who writes notes or evidence.
words.example: The recorder wrote the test result in the project log.
